tools_problematic.problem: The installed WinApp CLI has no build command.
tools_problematic.evidence: session-log.txt lines 2915-2973: winapp rejected 'build' and listed run but no build command.

tools_problematic.problem: It reported event 1000's generic managed wrapper code 0xe0434352 and a TypeLoad/FileNotFound hint instead of event 1026's embedded 0x8001010E.

tool_limitations.limitation: It crawled only the source directory and ignored external project items with Link metadata, so the mapping contained 4 files although the project linked shared App, MainPage, scenario XAML, styles, code, and assets.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Parse UWP project Link items, resolve common MSBuild properties, copy each external input to its Link path, and include it in triage.

tool_limitations.limitation: For managed crashes, its hint selection used the outer event 1000 code rather than the HRESULT embedded in event 1026.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Extract managed HRESULTs and prefer them when event 1000 reports 0xe0434352.

failed_apis.why_tried: The generated WinUI entry point invokes it before constructing the application.
failed_apis.root_cause: Unresolved in the trial. Event 1026 showed 0x8001010E with only generated Program.Main and Application.Start frames, while the skill incorrectly directed the agent away from entry-point/toolchain comparison.
failed_apis.fix: No code fix was proven in the trial. The reusable diagnostic is to reproduce an untouched scaffold with the same TFM/package versions, then align template/package/runtime if it fails identically.

doc_errors.correct: Use native dotnet build; the standalone WinApp CLI exposes run but not build.

doc_errors.where: SKILL.md Step 3 and MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md Diagnosing Startup Crashes
doc_errors.wrong: A generated/custom STA Program.Main is categorically not the problem.
doc_errors.correct: When event 1026 contains only Program.Main -> Application.Start, compare an untouched scaffold before changing migrated UI or entry-point apartment code.

doc_errors.wrong: The bootstrap is a complete inventory of the UWP project.
doc_errors.correct: A complete inventory must include external project items represented by Include plus Link metadata, not only files physically beneath the source folder.

special_apis.special_handling: They remained usable from WinUI 3; the migration preserved their calls and required no API replacement.

errors_encountered.error: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1: Target not found; the immediate Test-Path returned False.
errors_encountered.root_cause: The scaffold, bootstrap, and self-check were launched in parallel even though each depends on the preceding command.
errors_encountered.fix: Wait for dotnet new to exit successfully, then run bootstrap, then run Test-Path.

errors_encountered.root_cause: The skill documented a command absent from the installed WinApp CLI.
The manually reconstructed linked App.xaml retained x:Class TextSegmentation.App while App.xaml.cs used SDKTemplate.App.
errors_encountered.fix: Align App.xaml x:Class and xmlns with the code-behind namespace.

errors_encountered.error: WMC0909 could not resolve local:Scenario, WMC1111 x:Bind DataTemplate requires x:DataType, followed by WMC9999.
errors_encountered.root_cause: The manually reconstructed shared shell referenced Scenario through the wrong XAML namespace.
errors_encountered.fix: The trial removed the invalid x:DataType and used Binding Title.

errors_encountered.error: Manifest referenced missing Assets\StoreLogo-sdk.png and targeted Windows.Universal.
errors_encountered.root_cause: The UWP manifest was copied without completing the documented desktop manifest reconciliation.
errors_encountered.fix: Reference an existing StoreLogo.png and set TargetDeviceFamily to Windows.Desktop.

errors_encountered.error: CS0246 Frame not found, with secondary WMC9999.
errors_encountered.root_cause: A newly added Frame property lacked using Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls.

errors_encountered.error: XAML compiler input.json was in use by another process.
errors_encountered.root_cause: dotnet build, dotnet run, Test-AppLaunch, and the validator were launched concurrently against the same obj directory.
errors_encountered.fix: Run build, launch, and validation sequentially.

errors_encountered.error: Test-AppLaunch reported no build output or an incomplete layout.
errors_encountered.root_cause: Launch checks ran concurrently before their corresponding build completed.
errors_encountered.fix: Wait for a successful build before launching.

errors_encountered.error: COMException 0x8001010E: Application Object must initially be accessed from the multi-thread apartment.
errors_encountered.root_cause: Unresolved; event 1026 contained only generated Program.Main -> Application.Start frames, and the skill's generic managed-exception hint sent diagnosis toward migrated startup code.
errors_encountered.fix: No trial fix. First compare an untouched scaffold using the exact toolchain; align template/package/runtime if the scaffold reproduces it.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Bootstrap failed once and both self-checks printed False around a successful scaffold/bootstrap.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: One failed parallel attempt, then one successful bootstrap rerun.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: The agent reran bootstrap after scaffold completion and then reread its artifacts.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: State explicitly that the three bootstrap commands are a sequential dependency chain and must not be parallelized.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: The generated mapping had only four rows, forcing manual discovery and reconstruction of the shared shell, XAML, styles, and assets.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: Most of the pre-build migration work reconstructed files omitted from the bootstrap.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: The bootstrap ignored external csproj Link items.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: The agent manually read the UWP project and sibling shared content and created the missing target files.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Teach Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 to copy and map linked external project inputs.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: The mandated build command failed before compilation.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: One failed winapp build, then a switch to dotnet build.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: The skill documented a nonexistent WinApp CLI command.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Replace every winapp build instruction with dotnet build.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Launch checks saw incomplete layouts and one run failed on a locked XAML compiler input.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: Three multi-command batches mixed build, launch, run, and validation.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Operations sharing bin/obj and requiring build output were incorrectly treated as independent.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Later builds completed, but the pattern recurred.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Prominent sequential build -> launch -> validate wording.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: The agent changed navigation timing and UseRidGraph, but the same entry-point-only COMException persisted.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: At least four launch attempts reported the same startup failure.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: The helper surfaced the generic outer CLR code and the docs asserted the generated STA entry point was not the issue, despite an event 1026 stack with no migrated frame.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Unresolved; the final response correctly reported runs=false.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Prefer event 1026's HRESULT and require a pristine-scaffold comparison when no migrated stack frame exists.

missing_tooling.need: Automatic import of external csproj Link items.
missing_tooling.would_have_saved: Manual reconstruction of the shared application shell, both scenario XAML files, styles, and linked assets.
